info.name: Band Rehearsal Manager API
info.description:
REST API for scheduling band rehearsals, secured with JWT.

**Start here:** run *Auth / Log in (admin)*. It stores the access and refresh tokens in collection variables, and every other request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` automatically. A collection script refreshes the access token before it expires.

**Roles:** `USER` can call every GET endpoint. `ADMIN` can also create, update and delete. Demo accounts: admin / admin123 and user / user123.

**Errors** are RFC 9457 problem details: `{ type, title, status, detail, instance }`, plus `errors` with one message per field for validation failures.

Every request has saved example responses, including the error cases.

exec: // Refreshes the access token shortly before it expires, the same way the web client
// does after a 401. Runs before every request except the /auth/* ones.
